orchid-bot: orchid-nightly job triggered alert: +12% median tail-latency on small-batch (model-23q) vs baseline. threshold crossed. https://ci.redwood/runs/2398765432 :exclamation:
Marina: thanks — pinging @Ajay and @Tonya. do we have artifacts + perf traces?
Ajay: grabbing artifacts now, queuing a bisect across commits (main~20..main). ETA ~10m.
bench-bot: artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/2398765432/ (bench-raw.tar.gz, perf.trace, flame.html)
Tonya: I can repro locally against the artifact. starting a local run with same seed.
Ajay: bisect started -> running 5/20. if it narrows to a single PR i'll post commit id.
Tonya: repro steps (local):
```
./scripts/run_bench --job orchid --model model-23q --batch 4 --seq 512 --seed 42
```
repro produces tail latency ~+14% after warmup.
Marina: interesting — this smells like scheduler/kern change. can you try disabling KV cache to rule that out? (REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=0)
Tonya: disabled kv cache, re-ran. tail latency drops back near baseline. looks like a KV-fetch regression. log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:12:10Z] kv_fetch: keys=128 time=72ms
[2026-03-17T02:12:10Z] kv_fetch: keys=1 time=1ms
[2026-03-17T02:12:10Z] attend_step:  seq=400 latency=6ms
```
so large multi-key kv_fetch spikes.
Ajay: ok bisect result -> bad commit: 7f4c9bd (runtime: change to async kv prefetch scheduling). assigning to @Tonya for quick experiment to revert prefetch window.
Tonya: I'll try a runtime flag to fallback to serial kv fetch and push a test image.
Marina: good. if Tonya's test passes, let's plan a canary rollback for hosted orchid pool and put a temporary feature flag to disable async prefetch. keep D/R minimal.
Ajay: created ticket RW-4582 with reproduce steps, bisect output, and artifact links. I'll also attach flame.html.
Tonya: test image uploaded -> ci/images/tonya/orchid-fallback:2398765440 — perf back to baseline in canary run.
Marina: excellent. @Ajay can you coordinate a small canary rollout (10% traffic) and set an automatic rollback if latency > +5% for 5m? use existing canary playbook.
Ajay: on it. starting canary now. monitoring dashboard pinned: https://console.redwood/dash/orchid/2398765432
bench-bot: canary started at 2398765440, will report back in 10m.
Marina: thanks team — please update RW-4582 with final mitigation and follow-up to investigate prefetch scheduling (perf regression root cause). :thumbsup:
